emma: Ran a new synthetic bench focused on long-context churn + repeated KV re-use. seeing steady RSS growth over ~8h on the long-context suite, even though overall cache hit rate is ~92%.

emma: quick summary: workload simulates 50k sessions, average seq_len 12k tokens, interleaved prefixes to force fragmentation. eviction rate spikes at ~70% load windows and memory climbs 5-7% per hour until OOM.

emma: attaching a small excerpt from the harness run (stacked output):
```
[run] start: 2025-11-02T03:00:00Z
KV hits: 92034 / 100000 (92.03%)
Evictions: 1832 (burst windows)
Memory: 12.1GB -> 12.8GB -> 13.5GB (8h)
Fragmentation metric (samples): avg_free_runs=3.2, max_run=48, extents_reused=0.78
profiling: top allocators: kv_store::slot_map (48%), slab_pool (22%), runtime_buffers (18%)
```

raj: ouch. can you repro with a smaller run locally? want a repro harness to run under instruments.

emma: yes, I can repro with a 30m run that shows same slope. command I used:
```bash
./bench --suite long-churn --concurrency 32 --sessions 5000 --seq 12000 --seed 42 --evict-policy lru_window
```
config snippet I used: 
```json
{"kv_pool_mb": 16384, "evict_batch": 128, "prefetch": true, "compaction_interval_s": 300}
```

maria: can you share the jemalloc stats and `mallinfo` snapshot? also try `--compaction-interval 60` to see if more frequent compaction helps. fragmentation numbers look like we aren't reusing extents efficiently.

emma: putting the small repro logs here (paste):
```
[30m run] KV hits 91.8% Evictions 623 Memory 12.3GB -> 12.7GB
jemalloc: allocated=8.9GB active=10.5GB metadata=120MB
mallctl: decay_time=10 epoch_inc -> slab rundown shows 14% internal fragmentation
```

kevin: fwiw I instrumented the sticky-kv allocator yesterday. two notes: 1) our slab rotation uses a timestamp bucket which can leave small trailing extents if prefix reuse is skewed, 2) the reuse fastpath isn't hit when `evict_batch` > 64 because the code bails to a slower scan when batch sizes are large. both could explain the slow drift.

kevin: small patch idea: (pseudocode)
```c++
if (evict_batch > 64) evict_batch = min(evict_batch, 256); // avoid huge scans, keep reuse path engaged
// bump compaction trigger when fragmentation > 12%
if (fragmentation_pct > 12) schedule_compaction_immediate();
```

ops: can we run the 30m repro on a dedicated pool with pinned GPU/CPU so noisy neighbors are out? i'll schedule a slot tomorrow morning and post the run id. also we should run with `JEMALLOC_CONF:lg_dirty_mult:0` to force smaller dirty pages retention.

emma: thanks — will run with the smaller batch and forced jemalloc config. will also collect heap profiles (`jeprof`) and an `addr2line`-annotated flame.

dev-bot: CI bench job #4621 started (long-churn / 30m) on runner-7. logs: https://ci.internal/4621

maria: when you have the jeprof flame, please also collect the kv-slot histogram (`/debug/kv/slot_hist`) and the extent free-list snapshot. that will make it easier to correlate allocator churn with eviction bursts.

emma: next steps: (1) run repro on dedicated pool with JEMALLOC_CONF and compaction=60, (2) gather jeprof + slot_hist + jemalloc stats, (3) try kevin's small change locally, (4) schedule a longer 8h run if the slope persists.

kevin: i can open a short PR with logging around the reuse fastpath so we can see why it bails. small, safe, and toggled behind a flag.

ops: slot scheduled: 2025-11-03T08:00Z runner-7. i'll ping when done.

emma: ack — I'll post results in this thread and attach artifacts. thanks all :thumbsup:
